name: mischief
description: Chaos for your detection: during working hours, briefly stops services, kills processes and opens decoy ports, whatever its account can reach, always puts things back, and keeps a ledger to score what your team caught.

services.about: only these systemd units (space-separated); blank = any running service its account is allowed to stop

processes.about: only these process names; blank = any process its account is allowed to kill (its own session excepted)

spare.about: never touch these, even if reachable (unit or process names, space-separated)

ports.about: range for decoy listening ports (opened, held, closed)

window.about: local hours it may act in (START-END), so people are around to notice and respond

hold.about: seconds each prank lasts before it's undone

chance.about: percent chance of a prank at each roll (every 30 minutes)

allow_root.about: run as root? 'no' by default: give it a scoped account instead, since as root 'whatever it can reach' is everything
